covered_report_window: Friday, October 23, 2026 after the U.S. market close through Monday, October 26, 2026 before the U.S. market open.
market_context_summary: Oil-shock risk dominates: Brent rose 3.6% to $117.20 and roughly three quarters of S&P 500 constituents were lower, after Thursday's Nasdaq fell 2.6%. High rates and volatile risk appetite raise the hurdle for leveraged REITs and premium cyclicals; high energy prices help ARLP but pressure MMYT's airline-sensitive demand.

methodology.disparity_definition: 0.25 times the range of the three direction scores plus 0.50 times the range of the three reversal-risk values, rounded to the nearest integer; lower is tighter agreement.
methodology.lessons_review: No new framework change. Existing timing, key-metric, high-bar, low-bar reversal and disagreement guardrails were applied.
